qualification.note: detectability is a predeclared selector-identifiability precondition; the live band detector fires at 0.50 x peak

selection.rule: maximize sum(min(cap_gain, base_pen)) over 5-subsets with transition coverage and >=2 distinct caps; lexicographic tie-break

selector.preregistered_note: level list is the model-predicted post-transition probe throughput C/(k*(1+gamma*(k-1))) at k=16; nearest level wins; no drop by deadline => healthy (16, 1 MiB)
selector.pre_live_review: classification window fixed at 25 s with >= 1 post-drop sample before any W1-W6 live run: a 20-sample window would take up to ~200 s under the strongest frozen cap (request durations ~10 s), exceeding the download duration; time-based window avoids that

adaptive.baseline_definition: per_workload_best_fixed = live fixed-grid argmin per workload; family_best_fixed = live fixed-grid argmin minimizing the mean over the six workloads
adaptive.analysis: paired per-block ratios vs each baseline; geometric mean; bootstrap 95% CI; win counts; invalid runs preserved and reported (selector aborts count as losses)

live_protocol.exclusion: invalid/aborted runs preserved, reported, never dropped silently
